title: Promises we meant to keep
author: Monica Murphy
description: It’s an emotional romance about two young people who meet again after years apart and realize their feelings never truly disappeared.

title: Powerless
author: Lauren Roberts
genre: Fantasy; Romance; Mystery; Adventure; Drama; Young Adult
description: Is a thrilling romantasy about young girl, who’s living a world where abilities determine your worth. She has to keep her true identity a secret and learn how to blend in with the elite

title: Alchemised
author: SenLinYu
description: The book starts with the end of a war where the enemy has won and conquered the world. The main female character is captured by her swore enemies in order to gain information regarding the existence of remaining rebels and their whereabouts. The main obstacle is that she has hidden this information in the very depths of her mind and the only person who can unravel it is the main male character who later in the story appears to be her former lover she doesn’t remember. The beginning of the book starts in the middle of the story in order to keep the reader questioning what had happened and will she eventually remember and therefore survive.

title: Lights out
author: Navessa Allen
description: It’s about a woman that works in healthcare and has an interest in an influencer who she actually knows in real life. The guy realises that he has met her and starts stalking her.

title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
author: Holly Jackson
description: A girl decides to investigate a murder for her school project. The murder is very famous in her town and has hard time connecting the dots, while there are people trying to stop her finding the truth.

title: The Inheritance Games
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
description: A girl inherits everything from a man she doesn't know and is forced to live in his mansion with his 4 nephews. They solve different riddles trying to find why she inherited everything the old man had.

title: The Naturals
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
description: 17-year-old girl named who joins a secret FBI program for gifted teenagers

title: The Cruel Prince
author: Holly Black
description: Jude is a human girl living in the terrifying and beautiful world of faeries. Surrounded by deception, power, and deadly games, she wants nothing more than to prove that she belongs. But Prince Cardan, cruel and impossible to read, seems determined to make her life miserable.

title: The Mystery of Three Quarters
author: Sophie Hannah
description: In The mystery of three quarters it's not all clear that a crime has been committed. Hercule Poirot is pressed into service when multiple people start showing up at his door berating him for sending them letters accusing them of a murder they hadn't committed. The victim is someone who seemingly died of natural causes. So is it murder? Who is the mysterious letter writer? And what is the connection between the accused?

title: Long way down
author: Jason Reynolds
description: William Holloman is ready to get revenge on the person who murdered his older brother, Shawn. As Will rides the elevator down from his eighth-floor apartment, a new person, who is dead, gets on on each floor and tells a story about their lives.

title: Three daughters of Eve
author: Elif Shafak
description: A tale of woman, who gets shaken out of her stable well adjusted mode of upper class living in contemporary Istanbul. A story of self-discovery.

title: The Hunger Games
author: Suzanne Collins
description: A country divided by 12 districts choses one male and one female to fight to the death in order to remind the districts to keep the peace and to not rebel against the Capitol. The existence of a winner of the games is aimed at giving people a little hope for a change but not enough to make them believe that something would be able to change if they start to rebel against the government. But the girl from the poorest district wins and unknowingly stars a rebellion in the other districts not understanding the impact that she has had and the fact that she will is the only one able to make a difference.

title: City of Bones
author: Cassandra Clare
genre: Fantasy; Romance; Mystery; Drama; Young Adult
description: A girl is thrown into the world of Shadowhunters - half-human, half-angels fighting demons and protecting the human world.

title: Shantaram
author: Gregory David Roberts
description: The autor telling about a run from an australian prison aistralian who finds redemtion in Mumbai, India. The main character Lynn opens a free clinic in slums, but at the same time is inserted into the criminal world, participating in arms trafficking and falsifying documents.The novel is based on an actual case of the author.

title: Twisted Love
author: Ana Huang
description: A guy who takes care to protect his best friends sister while he is away. He moves in his friends place to be close to her. She is not happy about it mainly because his cold and possessive character but eventually she fells in love, only to find out that all of this was a plan to use her and her brother to get to their father for revenge. What he doesn't realise is what he actually looses this way - her and her brother. In the end he follows her in London to try and get her back.
